verdict.rationale: Paperspace docs say region is one of the choices made when creating a machine, and machines come with persistent storage, so users can pick where VM data lives. Nothing in the evidence covers data-residency guarantees, which regions exist, or region choice for Notebooks, shared drives or Deployments. Missing for 10: documented list of available regions, explicit data-residency/compliance commitments, region control for non-Machine storage products, independent corroboration.
